name: noteflare
description: Keep your notes on Cloudflare. Keep them to yourself. Google Keep–style notes with end-to-end encryption on Cloudflare Workers + D1.

scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler deploy && bun run db:migrate:remote

DB.description: D1 database that stores encrypted notes. Created automatically.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Zero Trust team domain, e.g. https://myteam.cloudflareaccess.com. Type todo for now; the app stays locked (401) until Access is configured.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Optional: only these emails (or @domain) may use NoteFlare, checked by the Worker on top of your Access policy. Comma-separated. Empty means whoever Access allows.

UPDATE_CHECK_REPO.description: GitHub repository checked for new NoteFlare releases (owner/repo). Set it to your fork, or to off to disable the check.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Application Audience (AUD) tag of the Cloudflare Access application protecting this Worker. Type todo for now and replace it once Access is set up.
